body:
Build the shell (solace-cli/frontend):
1. Add Lustre, plus modem for client-side routing. Pull in board and migration as Gleam path dependencies and call their register().
2. The view is the menu bar (Board, Migration; highlight the current page) above the element for the current route, chosen from the URLs in step 1.
3. index.html holds the font, base styles and the menu bar's CSS. main.mjs takes over the dragstart rule and uses composedPath.
4. Build to priv/app.js the same way the board README does.
5. Test the route → element choice in gleam.

Broader context:
## Decisions (from the human)
- All pages served by solace serve stay on :3030, each at its own path, with a menu bar at the top for switching between them.
- A new wrapper project, solace-cli/frontend, owns the HTML page, the menu bar and the routing.
- Each app (board, contract view, migration) is a Lustre component (a custom element). The apps stay decoupled so any of them can be replaced. The shell knows only each app's tag name, its attributes and its register() function.
- Lustre throughout.

## What the code shows that shapes the plan
- Today the board starts with lustre.start(…, "#app"), in both solace_board.main and solace_view.main. src/main.mjs chooses between them by looking for /view in the path. That choice moves into the shell.
- Lustre 5 components always render inside a shadow DOM (an open shadow root by default). By default, adopt_styles copies the document's stylesheets in once, when the component is created. on_disconnect is available for cleanup.
- Several pieces of the board's JS reach into document and will break inside a shadow root:
- api.mjs images() listens for paste, drop and change on document and checks e.target. Outside the component, e.target is the host element, not the editor. change events don't leave the shadow root at all, so picking an image would stop working.
- api.mjs wrap() uses document.getElementById.
- layout.mjs:
- viewport_width and viewport_height use document.querySelector('.view-drawing').
- keys() checks event.target.closest(...). Inside a shadow root that would let typing in a field trigger diagram shortcuts.
- keys() also looks up .view-diagram on document.
- focus_node uses querySelector('[data-node=…]').
- resizer() matches .view-panel-grip and puts view-resizing on body.
- main.mjs has a document-level dragstart listener.
- What does carry over: --panel-width on documentElement reaches into components, and location.pathname/search still work.
- Fixes: use event.composedPath()[0] instead of e.target, attach listeners to the component's root, and pass that root (or an element) to the helpers instead of searching document.
- CSS: the board's styles live in board/index.html. For apps that can be swapped, each component should carry its own styles (a <style> in its view). @font-face (drawing.woff) has to be declared in the shell's document, because font faces declared inside a shadow root don't load.
- The server routes (Rust solace serve) are outside this Solace root, so I couldn't see them.
- Each Solace session changes one project. So the work below is split per project (migration, board, frontend), plus a server step done outside Solace.
title: Migration App Planning: Build the shell
